Abange mmwe abakkiriza temwetumiikirizanga mu maaso ga Allah n’Omubaka We (ne mwogera ku kintu nga Omubaka tannakyogerako) era mutye Allah mazima Allah Muwulizi nnyo Mumanyi.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza temusitulanga amaloboozi ga mmwe okusinga ku ddoboozi lya Nnabbi, era temumwatuliranga ebigambo nga abamu mu mmwe bwe baatulira bannaabwe, emirimu gyammwe gireme kwonooneka nga temugenderedde.
Mazima abo abakkakkanya amaloboozi gaabwe awali Omubaka wa Allah, abo beebo Allah be yatukuza emitima gyabwe babe nga bamutya. Balina ekisonyiwo n'empeera ensukkulumu.
Mazima abo abakukowoolera emabega w’ebisenge abasinga obungi mu bo tebategeera.
Singa mazima bo bagumiikiriza okutuusa lw'ofuluma n'ogenda gye bali, kyandibadde kirungi gye bali, era Allah Musonyiyi Waakisa nnyo.
Abange mmwe abakkiriza singa omwononefu abaleetera amawulire muteekwa okwetegereza, mube nga temutuusa kabi ku bantu mu butamanya, olwo nno ne mukeesa nga mwejjusa olw'ekyo kye mwakoze.

Era mumanye nti mazima omubaka wa Allah ali mu mmwe, singa abagondera mu bigambo ebisinga obungi (nga bwe mubiraba), mwandifunye obuzibu, naye ddala Allah yabaagazisa Obukkiriza n'abulabisa bulungi eri emitima gyammwe, n'abakyayisa obukaafiiri n’obwononefu n’obujeemu, (abo abataliimu mize egimenyeddwa waggulu) bo be baluŋŋamu.
(Nga ebyo byonna) birungi era nga byengera ebiva ewa Allah, era bulijjo Allah Mumanyi nnyo Mugobansonga.

Ebibinja bibiri mu bakkiriza bwe birwanagananga muteekwa mulongoose wakati wa byombi (mu bitabaganye) ekimu bwe kirumba ekirala olwo nno mulwanyise ekyo ekiba kirumbye okutuusa lwe kidda eri Ekigambo kya Allah. Bwe kiba kizze kale mutabaganye wakati wa byombi mu bwesimbu, era mukole obwenkanya, mazima Allah ayagala abakola obwenkanya.
Ddala abakkiriza ba luganda n’olwekyo mulongoose (mutabaganye) wakati wa baganda bammwe, era mutye Allah mube nga musaasirwa.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza abantu (abamu) mu mmwe tebanyoomanga bantu bannaabwe, anti oluusi bayinza okuba nga be balungi okusinga bo, wadde abakyala okunyooma bakyala bannaabwe, anti oluusi bayinza okuba nga be balungi okusinga bo, era temwerengezzanga, era temweyitanga amannya ag'emize, erinnya erisinga obubi ly'eryo erikkakkanya omuntu oluvannyuma lw'okuba nti Mukkiriza. Omuntu (akola ekyo) bw'ateenenya, abo bo be beeyisa obubi.

Abange mmwe abakkiriza mwewale okuteebereza okusinga obungi, anti okuteebereza okumu kiba kyonoono, era temwekettanga, era abamu mu mmwe tebageyanga bannaabwe, abaffe omu ku mmwe yandiyagadde okulya ennyama ya muganda we nga mufu! Ate nga mwakitamwa dda, era mutye Allah mazima Allah akkiriza okwenenya Musaasizi nnyo.

Abange mmwe abantu mazima Ffe twabatonda nga tubaggya mu musajja n’omukazi, era ne tubafuula amawanga n'ebika mulyoke mumanyagane, mazima abasinga ekitiibwa ewa Allah y'oyo abasinga okumutya, mazima Allah Mumanyi nnyo amanyidde ddala ebintu okuva ku nsibuko yaabyo.

Bannamalungu baagamba nti tukkirizza, bagambe nti temunnakkiriza, wabula mugambe nti twewaddeyo eri Abasiraamu (ne tuwona okuttibwa oba okuwambibwa) era Obukkiriza tebunnayingira mu mitima gyammwe naye singa mugondera Allah n’Omubaka We tagenda kukendeeza ku mpeera ya mirimu gyammwe kintu kyonna. Mazima Allah Musonyiyi Musaasizi nnyo.

Mazima Abakkiriza abannamaddala beebo abakkiriza Allah n’Omubaka We, ate ne batabuusabuusa (ebyo bye bakkiriza) era ne balafuubana mu kuweereza mu Kkubo lya Allah nga bakozesa emmaali yaabwe n'emyoyo gyabwe, abo nno, bo, be Bakkiriza abaamazima.
Bagambe nti mumanyisa Allah eddiini yammwe nga ate Allah amanyi ebyo ebiri mu ggulu omusanvu n'ensi, era bulijjo Allah amanyidde ddala ebikwata ku buli kintu.
Bakweraalaasizaako nti baasiramuka, bagambe nti temundaalaasizaako Busiraamu bwammwe, wabula Allah abenyumiririzaako okuba nti yabaluŋŋamya eri Obukkiriza bwe muba nga muli baamazima.
Mazima Allah amanyi ebyekusifu by'omuggulu omusanvu n'ensi, era Allah alabira ddala ebyo bye mukola.
